speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: The Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) will strengthen families as the bedrock of our society.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will strengthen the Families For Life (FFL) movement.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: This will provide families more convenient access to peer support groups, marriage preparation, parenting and grandparenting programmes at the local community level.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: For families that face more challenges, we will provide timely family-centric interventions such as marriage support for minor and young marriages, divorce support, and family counselling.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will do this through the nationwide network of 10 FSCs offering the Strengthening Families Programme.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will continue to invest heavily in the early childhood sector to provide all children access to affordable and quality preschools.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will enhance training and career progression for early childhood educators, keep salaries and working conditions competitive, and maintain the high quality of preschool education.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: In our Forward Singapore conversations, parents expressed their desire for more options to care for their young children, especially infants.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will study new care options apart from infant care facilities, to meet varying preferences and needs.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will continue working towards our shared vision where men and women partner each other as equals.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: One key area is to encourage greater women’s representation in leadership roles, building on the good progress made in raising the proportion of women on boards.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will enable persons with disabilities (PwDs) to live independent and fulfilling lives, through the Enabling Masterplan 2030.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: SG Enable will launch regional Enabling Business and Enabling Services hubs to provide employment support to, and bring social support services closer to PwDs and their caregivers.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: MSF will also expand capacity in early intervention services and make preschools more inclusive to support children with developmental needs.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: To foster a more caring and inclusive society, we will work with corporates and the community to shift mindsets and enhance support for families with PwDs in areas such as cost of care and post-school life.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will strengthen our social safety nets for lower-income families and enable them to bounce back stronger.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: ComCare will be regularly updated to reflect basic expenditure patterns of lower-income families.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Early childhood development for children from lower-income families will start them on the right path.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will also ensure that social services are comprehensive, convenient, and coordinated so that vulnerable families can get the help they need quickly and easily.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: To this end, Community Link (ComLink) officers and volunteer befrienders have adopted a family-centric approach in supporting families with children living in rental housing.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: MSF will also be integrating social programmes under ComLink, such as KidSTART, UPLIFT Community Network, and Project Dian@M3.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We are studying how to empower ComLink families to take further action to improve their circumstances and that of their children, by augmenting and supplementing their efforts to uplift themselves.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Through Forward Singapore, we will strengthen partnerships with volunteers, the community, and corporates to help these families achieve stability, self-reliance, and social mobility.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will take a family-based approach to rehabilitate youth offenders, so that they can turn their lives around.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will also work with the community to protect families at risk of domestic violence.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We have made it easier and more convenient for those experiencing or witnessing domestic violence to make reports, so that survivors can get help from social service professionals.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will amend the Women’s Charter to better protect survivors and hold perpetrators accountable even as we support their rehabilitation.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Twenty twenty-three is the Year of Celebrating Social Service Partners for the good work of social service agencies (SSAs), businesses, and Institutes of Higher Learning (IHLs).

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will accord similar recognition to social service professionals and volunteers.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will continue to partner SSAs in their transformation and extend more support through the Community Capability Trust, so that their digitalisation processes, people practices, and volunteer management capabilities are future-ready.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: To ensure effective service delivery, we will prioritise funding for outcomes and improve data sharing and integrated case management through platforms such as Case Connect and One Client View.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will also reduce administrative and regulatory burden and streamline reporting requirements while still ensuring good governance.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Businesses and organisations have assets, expertise and networks they can creatively leverage to support their philanthropic efforts and create sustained social impact.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Together, we can secure a better future for ourselves and our children.
